_comment: Baseline for the embedding-transfer proxy experiment: identical shape/data/schedule to proxy-v05-transfer.json but warm-started from a RANDOM-init embedding (code/01-tokenizer/embedding_transfer.py --out-random) instead of FVT transfer. Everything else (non-embedding weights, data, LR schedule, steps) is held fixed so the loss-curve gap is attributable to the embedding init alone.
